bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9. GREYT REMLAP handed in a solid effort in defeat at Scone first up with Mikayla Weir aboard. He can only now present race-fitter when the addition of blinkers should now aid his cause! DALLAS DUKE kept trying in defeat on debut at Wyong. Switching to the country circuit now opens the door to making natural improvement with winkers added to his gear. CREDIBILITY begins his second campaign today after trialing at the beginning of July at Scone. This short journey should be ideal first up. FRENCH MELODY will concede race-day experience to most on debut this afternoon. She has however trialed twice since a spell and if she doesn't present where she was also an acceptor today at Ipswich, she must be treated with respect.

raceTips.comment: The horse Greyt Remlap finished within a length of when resuming has subsequently won well again in stronger grade which reads well. That form lines jumps off the page for a race like this. Dallas Duke will have derived good benefit from a handy debut effort in what looked to be a decent maiden race. Opine has scope to improve back in distance post freshen for a new stable. Goodonya Ausbred looks suited coming back in distance with gear changes made.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 5, 11, 15. OCCUPATION kept trying in defeat at Grafton after blinkers had been added to his gear and he will have scope to further improve here at only his third start in his first campaign. ANTONUCCI did a good job to finish as close to the winner as she did last start at Port Macquarie when she became most unsuited in transit on the day. HABIB ALBI finished unplaced at Port Macquarie however his effort was better than it appears on paper. He's more than ready to now make his home track debut. MISS MIDAS TOUCH stepped up into this distance range when her second up Grafton effort was honest. Her third up effort was honest after she struck traffic problems here at home last campaign and she shouldn't be underestimated third up today.

raceTips.comment: Occupation ran a much improved race second up over this distance range and looks well poised to go one better in a race with a long tail to it. The wide barrier is the only negative, but with any luck he is deserving of favouritism. Kiwi Harmony didn't have much luck last time out before running on strongly. If that proves to be the right form reference race then Habib Albi and Antonucci go into the mix as they both come via it.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 5, 6, 7, 9. ENTERPRISE PRIVATE handed in an honest first up Doomben effort last start when he was produced within this testing distance range. He will have scope to improve with that effort now behind him.   SPENZALOT found the line strongly to score within this distance range last start at Tamworth and he can be expected to maintain his form when he now makes a Coffs Harbour debut. MAJORIAN did all but win at Kembla Grange. He now needs to cope with a step back from 2400m after a thirteen day break but he's in most astute hands and he should not be underestimated. FAY'S ANGELS wasn't disgraced when she finished unplaced last start at Randwick. She's proven here and she is far better placed against her awaiting opposition today.

raceTips.comment: Enterprise Private did more than enough when resuming, will strip fitter and from a much kinder barrier draw can settle closer today. Spenzalot is hard-fit and in good winning form which is hard to knock. No real negatives. Fay's Angels hasn't won for a while but hasn't been far away in handy form reference races relative to this. Outside of those three, there is a host of each-way chances but Majorian goes in as next best.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 4, 6, 9. STEFFI ELECTRICA found the line with no dangers when she led throughout third up at Grafton and she should have more to offer within the same distance range here today. BEER BARON dug deep to prevail over 1100m at Grafton. He's also proven over this journey and he can maintain his form when he returns to his home base today. JEWELS STATEMENT struck traffic problems when she still performed above market place expectations at Grafton and she's anything but out of place here. GET SOME FUN trialed late last month at her Taree home base, She is now ready to resume when she makes her Coffs Harbour debut today.

raceTips.comment: Initial race favourite Their Finest Hour comes out in preference to Saturday which opens the race up. Get Some Fun resumes off a solid trial effort and has the gate speed to be prominent in running. She should simply get every chance. Conversely Steffi Electrica draws wide but does come off a last start win and will have fans on that effort. Beer Baron is hard to catch but strikes a nice race to make it back to back wins. Cool Fizz disappointed first up but has scope to improve.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 4, 6, 9, 10. MY MUM'S TOYBOY has been given a freshen-up and he returns to home base with the claim for Grady Spokes aiding his cause. He can be forgiven for an unplaced Grafton effort last start when drawing a wide gate couldn't be coped with. MISTER BIANCO refused to shirk his task in defeat when he was resuming at Grafton. He endured a tough run on the day and he clearly has scope to now improve. LUNAITE resumes after trialing twice last month and this journey is not expected to create any problems for her first up. OAKFIELD DUKE should not be harshly judged for an unplaced second up Muswellbrook effort when his effort was better than it appears at face value.

raceTips.comment: Lunaite has a compelling record over this distance range, maps for the softest of runs and has been subject to early market support. Mister Bianco found the line well when resuming as always improves with a run under his belt. Now gets up to his preferred distance range too. Happy to forgive the last run from My Mum's Toyboy. He was in good winning form prior and strikes a nice race to bounce back. Sir Carter has scope to improve second up and should get a soft lead throughout.

TOO DARN FINESSE displayed determination to score with Benjamin Osmond aboard at Grafton and she should have more to offer when she now makes her Coffs Harbour debut over the same distance. STORM MERCHANT was beaten at short odds at Grafton after he had been kept fresh. He will however appreciate the slight distance rise that now awaits when he presents fresh again today. CERTIFIED COPY scored first up at Rockhampton despite striking trouble on the day. He's race-fitter now and this race isn't beyond his reach. CUTEPI must be forgiven for an unplaced first up Sunshine Coast effort when she became completely unsuited in transit.

raceTips.comment: Certified Copy will have derived good benefit from his first up win and can utilise the inside draw. Can be a little hard to catch on the punt, but this is good placement. Storm Merchant was gallant in defeat last time out when well supported noting the winner has since nearly won a handy race since which reads well. Youwroteuponit was a couple off lengths off Storm Merchant last time but can bridge the margin over this slightly longer trip. Too Darn Finesse comes off a last start win in weaker company but drops significantly in weight and has upside.

raceTips.comment: Fortune drew wide when resuming, settled back but ran on strongly to/through the line when finding one better. Strips fitter and is very likely to settle closer which aids his case. bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 13, 14, 17. VIXENETTE was kept fresh before she kept trying in defeat over this distance last start at Grafton. She will be making her Coffs Harbour debut today and this race is clearly within her reach. SATIN AND CASH overcame trouble to score at her Grafton home base and she is now more than ready to appreciate a step up to tackle this trip for the first time. NO WOMAN NO CRY scored with authority within this distance range at Grafton and he can maintain his form here. TARA KODA still did all but win after she struck traffic problems at Grafton. Stepping back slightly in distance from 1700m is most unlikely to cause her problems here when she presents after an almost three week break.

raceTips.comment: Vixenette was coming off a longer gap between runs when up to this distance range last time out and was solid despite not winning. A race like this looks well within reach. Satin And Cash has won well over shorter in two of her last three runs and looks suited rising to the mile now. No Woman No Cry comes off a maiden win over the trip last time out but was drawing clear through the line so can measure up in this grade. Caledonian was held up before finding the line well last start, next best.
